trust_decision.summary: Filter values passed to get_events are rendered into raw SQL by Engine.build_filter_conditions; the decision is whether a string value can leave its quoted literal (MariaDB treats a trailing backslash as an escape). At the pinned commit, backslashes are already doubled before rendering.

landing_point.why: The advisory names get_events. The Event get_events formats the get_filters_cond output straight into a raw frappe.db.sql string.

fix_sites.entry_point: none (only the frappe.__version__ string changes from 16.32.0 to 16.33.0)

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Filter values that really contain a backslash, such as a Windows path, must still match their rows. At the pinned commit this already holds and is tested.

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89): string-literal escaping differential between pypika ValueWrapper and MariaDB backslash escapes

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Parameterise or whitelist filters only inside Event.get_events instead of escaping in the shared Engine.build_filter_conditions.
